summary: Full retest after refactor. Backend: 27/27 pytest cases pass (auth validation/409/401, unauth 401, boards CRUD + default columns, owner-only PATCH/DELETE, members invite/remove/404/403/owner-not-removable, tasks create/edit validation incl. priority + non-member assignee 400, move within/across columns with dense positions, cross-board column 400, PATCH column_id -> bottom, column CRUD with deleted_tasks, comments add/403/404, board cascade). Frontend: all requested flows verified via Playwright: auth errors, register, logout (token removed), session persists on reload, dashboard stats, create board -> 3 default columns, DnD (drop on card inserts before it, drop on column appends, cross-column, persists after reload), accessible column-select fallback (moves to bottom, modal closes), task edit modal now closes (iteration_1 bug fixed), task create with assignee/priority/due date, search/priority/assignee (Everyone/Unassigned/member)/Reset filters, comments (count on card, delete only on own), members modal (invite, 404 toast, remove, jordan sees owner note only), stranger gets board-error, column modal (iteration_1 bug fixed: rename, delete with confirm removes column + tasks), task delete confirm, board settings rename/description persist + delete navigates to dashboard. One real bug found: dropping a card on itself moves it to the top of its column.

minor.issue: due_date format isn't validated (any string is stored), even though the docs say YYYY-MM-DD.
Returns 403 'no access' instead of 404, because membership() runs before the existence check. Not wrong per the docs, but it can mislead users.

ui_bugs.issue: Dropping a dragged card onto itself (or a tiny drag that ends on the same card) moves it to position 0 and the server keeps that position. Reproduced: In Progress [5,1,4,6] became [5 moved from index 2 to 0]. RCA: indexOf(t) filters out the dragged task, then findIndex returns -1 for the dragged card itself. The client reorder() then slices (0,-1), and the server clamps -1 to 0. Fix: in onDropHere, return early when t.id === drag.id, or make onDropAt ignore index < 0.

issues: The greeting always says 'Good morning' whatever the time of day
The MoreHorizontal icon on board tiles looks like a menu but does nothing (it is inside the tile button)
'Open tasks' stat counts Done tasks too
The page has no header or logout and the message is left-aligned in a narrow block. It works but looks bare.

Drops use insert-before semantics, so moving a card down by one slot only works by dropping it on the card two below or at the end of the column. Consider using the top/bottom half of the hovered card.

action_items: Fix the self-drop bug in BoardColumn.jsx onDropHere (skip when the target is the dragged task / index < 0).
Optional: validate due_date format server-side; pluralize the board count; make the greeting match the time of day or use a neutral one; remove the tile menu icon or make it work.
critical_code_review_comments: BoardColumn indexOf() returns -1 for the dragged card itself, which causes the self-drop bug above.
TaskModal sends the whole task object (assignee_name, comment_count, created_at...) in PATCH. The server ignores the extra fields, but sending only the editable fields would be cleaner.
The comment DELETE route checks authorship only, not board membership, so a removed member can still delete their old comments. Acceptable, but worth knowing.
server.py is an httpx proxy to Node on API_PORT. Every request adds an extra hop, and the proxy doesn't restart Node if it crashes.

rca of the issue: Self-drop: BoardColumn.indexOf = col.tasks.filter(t=>t.id!==drag.id).findIndex(t=>t.id===target.id) returns -1 when target === drag. onDropAt(col.id,-1) then sends position -1, and placeTask clamps it to Math.max(0,...) = 0, so the card goes to the top. Repro: drag any non-first card and release it on itself. Mitigation: guard with `if (t.id === drag?.id) return;` in onDropHere (and/or ignore index < 0 in onDropAt).
